description: Gemini CLI agent integration, built in to the application.
configuration.title: Gemini
configuration.approval.allowAutoEdit: Offer the Auto Edit approval mode, which applies the agent's file edits without asking. When off, the mode is hidden and the Gemini CLI asks before every tool in it.
configuration.approval.allowYolo: Offer the YOLO approval mode, which runs every tool, including shell commands, without asking. When off, the mode is hidden and the Gemini CLI asks before every tool in it.
configuration.tools.allowShell: Let the agent run shell commands. Each command still asks first unless YOLO mode is on. When off, the Gemini CLI removes its shell tool.
command.appearance: Make It Yours: Theme, Font and Icons
walkthrough.look.title: Make it yours
walkthrough.look.description:
Pick a theme, a code font and file icons. Each choice applies at once.
[Choose a Look](command:gemini.appearance)
configuration.notifications.enabled: Show a system notification when an agent finishes or needs your permission while GeminiCode is in the background, and show how many agents are waiting on the Dock icon.
configuration.cli.checkForUpdates: Once a day, check the npm registry for a newer Gemini CLI and offer to install it. Nothing is installed without your click. No check is made when `#gemini.cli.version#` or `#gemini.cliPath#` is set.
configuration.app.checkForUpdates: Once a day, check the GeminiCode download page for a newer GeminiCode and say so. GeminiCode downloads nothing itself; the notice links to the page.
configuration.agents.worktreeSetup: A shell command run in each new agent branch's folder before the agent starts, such as `npm ci && cp "$GEMINI_SOURCE_REPOSITORY/.env" .`. `GEMINI_SOURCE_REPOSITORY` is the repository the branch came from. When empty, the repository's own `.gemini/worktree-setup.sh` runs if it has one. Runs only in trusted workspaces.
configuration.agents.ownBranch: Start every new agent in a Git repository on its own branch, in its own folder under `~/.geminicode/worktrees`, so agents working side by side never edit the same files. **Merge Back** on the agent brings its work into your branch. Off: agents work in the workspace folder, and **New Agent on Its Own Branch** does this for one agent.
configuration.chat.followAgent: Follow the agent: as it works, open each file it reads, and each file it edits once the edit is written, at the line it is on. Focus stays in the chat. Toggle it in the + menu of a chat's composer; new chats start the way you left it.
configuration.browser.enabled: Let agents open and use a page in the GeminiCode browser, to check the web app they are working on: read it, click, type and take screenshots. Each agent gets its own tab, marked "Gemini is using this page". Applies to agents started afterwards.
configuration.browser.allowOtherSites: Let agents open sites other than this machine's (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, files), after asking you once per site. When off, agents can only open local pages.
configuration.agent.startEarly: Start the Gemini CLI a few seconds after GeminiCode opens, once you have signed in, so the first prompt does not wait for it. It uses about 230 MB of memory before the first chat.
configuration.keepAwake: Keep the Mac from sleeping while any agent is working, so a long task is not paused when you step away. The display can still sleep. Ends as soon as no agent is working.
configuration.usageMeter.enabled: Show today's Gemini quota use in the Gemini status bar item's tooltip and in the chat's Usage and quota popover, and the percentage in the bar once a model passes 80%. Reads it every 10 minutes at most, and when the popover opens unless it was read in the last minute, with the sign-in the Gemini CLI saved. Google sign-in only.
configuration.inlineEdit.enabled: Inline edit (`⌘I` on a selection) and **Write Commit Message with Gemini**. Both send the selected code or the diff straight to a fast Gemini model, using the sign-in the Gemini CLI saved, without starting an agent.
configuration.inlineEdit.model: The model inline edit and commit messages use. `latestFlash` (the default) is the newest Flash model the installed Gemini CLI knows, or the previous one if your account can't use it yet, which keeps them to a second or two. `sameAsChat` uses the model last picked in chat, and Flash when that is Auto. Or enter a model name, such as `gemini-2.5-pro`.
configuration.cli.version: The version of GeminiCode's own copy of the Gemini CLI to run, such as `0.62.0`. When empty, the newest copy is used, installed or bundled with GeminiCode. Ignored when `#gemini.cliPath#` is set.
configuration.cliPath: Path to the Gemini CLI. Either a `gemini` executable or the CLI's JavaScript entry point (run with the application's bundled Node). When empty, GeminiCode's own copy is used (see `#gemini.cli.version#`): one installed from GeminiCode, the one bundled with it, or else `gemini` on `PATH`.

configuration.projectId: Google Cloud project ID the agent bills to, passed to the CLI as `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`. Use the project ID, not the project number. A workspace value wins over a user value; when neither is set, the organisation default and then the `GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT`, `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` and `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID` environment variables are used.
